summary: A family with uneven earnings would give up some take-home pay for a predictable filing season.
realLife: An Associated Press account entered in a 2019 House hearing record reported this case. McCreanor described how variable household income, chiefly from his wife's telecommunications work, made avoiding a surprise bill important to them. In guidance on its redesigned 2020 form, IRS explained how a worker who wanted a larger cushion could specify an extra amount for each paycheck.
